praises: 4.46/5 across 131 Best Buy reviews — one of the happiest buyer bases of any CA convertible
2K touch panel praised as bright and sharp for the price
Good battery life for classes and travel; quiet under normal loads
Copilot+ PC (40+ TOPS NPU) at a mainstream price
Light for a 14" convertible and the pen works well for note-taking
complaints: Plasticky deck flexes more than the OmniBook X siblings; hinge wobble reported
HP bloatware and trialware heavy out of the box
Fan spins up audibly on video calls in warm rooms
Soldered RAM, single M.2 — no upgrade path
Speakers are thin; volume fine but bass nearly absent

design_philosophy: The OmniBook 5 Flip is HP's mainstream convertible: last-gen-style chassis quality one step below the X line, but current-gen Copilot+ silicon and a good 2K touch panel at a price families actually pay. It is the spiritual successor to the Pavilion x360 rather than the Spectre, and its 4.46-star Best Buy following shows the formula lands.
